stationaryTimingProbe.initialTimingScreen: Require valid identity/completion/positive finite peaks, no numeric or UART failures. Full-core observed peak below 600us is a conservative provisional headroom screen, NOT a new controller deadline or a WCET proof. Review period/body/CAN context before deciding whether one motion qualification run can start.
stationaryTimingProbe.measurementLimits: Synthetic finite fixtures, unchanged live RTOS/interrupts and actual ARM float core. Bench call context differs from motion/event logger; direct contraction includes bypass fixtures. Peak values are not an exhaustive worst-case bound and are not enough alone to release formal experiments. Motion task must separately meet preserved 900/950/1000us checks.
